summary: BUG: Loader should be added on vendor/unpaid_invoices page
reported_issue: The vendor unpaid invoices page had no loading indicator while its data was being fetched (reported via video).
expected_after_fix: A loader/spinner should display on the vendor unpaid_invoices page while the invoice data is loading.
steps_i_followed: Navigated Parts > Vendors, opened a vendor (Aiwick Concrete) detail
Throttled the unpaid-invoices API response by ~2.5s to make any transient loader observable
Clicked the 'Unpaid Invoices' tab (route /parts/vendor/{id}/unpaid-invoices) and polled for spinner/loading elements
Let the request complete and confirmed the invoice table rendered
actual_now: While the (throttled) unpaid-invoices data was loading, a loader element appeared (one .q-spinner/.q-inner-loading progress indicator detected). After the request completed the Unpaid Invoices table rendered (e.g. credit C-9798, Balance -$645,456.00). The loader is present as required.
notes: Loader detected only by artificially delaying the API; on normal fast loads it flashes briefly, which is expected behavior for a loading indicator.
